name: scrutiny-fabric-tools
//biome: Pinned exactly, not ^: the D12 crypto-import ban is a biome nursery rule, and a minor bump that promotes or renames it would silently stop enforcing it. test/no-crypto.test.ts backs the ban independently.

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm rules:check && pnpm ownership:check && pnpm knip && pnpm build && pnpm publint && pnpm api-report:check && pnpm attw && pnpm size && pnpm audit && pnpm test

//pnpm: vitest ^4.1.11 (issue #77) patches GHSA-82fw-gwwq-j7x9 and moves the chain to vite 6.x; the vite override pins ^6.4.3 inside vitest 4's vite ^6||^7||^8 peer range so floating to vite 7/8 stays a deliberate decision, not an accident of a vitest minor. esbuild <0.25 lets any website reach the dev server. js-yaml <4.3.2 (via @changesets/cli's parse chain) carries quadratic-CPU advisories. nanoid <3.3.17 can loop indefinitely with a zero size. qs <6.16.0 (via @stryker-mutator/core → typed-rest-client) carries GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26, GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, and GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g; fast-uri <3.1.6 (via api-extractor → tsdoc-config → ajv) carries three URI-parsing advisories (GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8, GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc, GHSA-fph4-wmhf-6fwf). All are dev-only — the package ships only `diff` at runtime — but overriding is cheap and keeps `pnpm audit` clean so a real advisory is not lost in the noise. Drop each once its parent depends on a patched version directly. (`pnpm audit --prod` does not actually scope to production-only dependencies in this pnpm version's workspace mode — verified by comparing its output to plain `pnpm audit`, byte-identical — so these are pinned rather than relied on to be filtered out.)
